description: This file defines a PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_Resource_Registered' that extends 'Smarty_Resource' and implements methods for handling Smarty template resources, including populating source metadata, retrieving timestamps, loading content, and determining basenames.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Registered
classes.description: Class implementing registered resource handling for Smarty templates, including methods for populating source info, getting timestamps, loading content, and basename determination.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata from the resource, including filepath, uid, timestamp, and existence.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populates the source object with timestamp and existence info.

methods.name: getTemplateTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the modification timestamp of the template source, returning false if unavailable.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template source content by invoking the registered callback; throws exception if unable to load.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns the basename of the resource's name.
